questions: Could you tell me where you are from?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
Do you think you will continue living there in the future?
Do you work or are you a student?
What made you choose that particular field?
What is the most interesting aspect of your work or studies?
What are your future career plans?
What part of the day do you enjoy most?
What do you usually do on your weekends?
Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with other people?
How has your daily routine changed in recent years?

part_2_cue_cards.title: Describe a memorable journey you have taken
bullet_points: Where you went and how you travelled there
What you did during the journey
And explain why this journey was so memorable to you
part_3_questions: How has travel changed compared to the past?
Do you think tourism has more positive or negative effects on local communities?
Why do some people prefer travelling to remote and quiet places?
How might technological advances impact the way people travel in the future?

part_2_cue_cards.title: Describe a difficult challenge you faced and overcame
bullet_points: What steps you took to overcome it
And explain what you learned from this experience
part_3_questions: Why is it important for young people to face challenges?
Do you believe schools adequately prepare students for practical life difficulties?
How does modern technology make daily challenges easier or more difficult?
What qualities are most essential for strong leaders during a crisis?

part_2_cue_cards.title: Describe a piece of electronic technology you find very useful
bullet_points: What it is and how often you use it
How you learned to use it
What features make it so practical
And explain how it has impacted your daily life
part_3_questions: Do people rely too heavily on technological devices today?
How has communication between family members evolved with social media?
What ethical concerns arise from increasing automation and artificial intelligence?
Should governments regulate how digital platforms use personal data?
